svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ElecTrace: trace charges, critical points, and bonds across the frames of a reaction path.
svg.desc: Seven frames of the HCN to HNC example in the repository, a hand-defined static scan, not an optimized path. Each column is one frame drawn to scale with the C–N axis vertical, and the area of each atom is its Bader electron population. Ribbons join the bond critical points frame by frame, and the width of a ribbon at a frame is the density there. The C–N ribbon stays near 0.49 a.u. The other ribbon is one critical point on one track, tied to C and H through frame 02 and to N and H from frame 03, a candidate change of neighbors with confidence 0.19.
svg.text: Trace charges, critical points, and bonds
across the frames of a reaction path.
